title: 5 AI Tools Nobody Uses (But Should)
description:
Everyone’s talking about ChatGPT — but there’s a whole toolkit beyond it that’s quietly reshaping work and creativity. Perplexity gives answers with real sources so you can trust citations. Gamma turns ideas into polished, story-driven presentations in minutes. Claude is the writer’s companion for subtle, precise long-form text. Durable lets you spin up a functional website with AI, no developer required. ElevenLabs generates realistic voices that bring words to life. Most people know only one AI; the smartest use dozens. Follow HeadlessHub for more hidden AI gems.
